def plugin(path: str) -> str uses fs:
    """Read path and notes/../secret.txt through fs; return both joined by "|"; a failed read gives ""."""
    mine = fs.read(path) else ""
    theirs = fs.read("notes/../secret.txt") else ""
    return mine + "|" + theirs

def run_plugin(path: str) -> str uses fs:
    """Run plugin(path) with fs confined to notes, so every read outside notes yields ""."""
    pre path != ""
    post "|" in out
    with fs = fs.sub("notes"):
        r = plugin(path)
    return r
